source.limitations: Transcribed from Butler County Health District Registered Professionals PDF dated 23 July 2026 (Registered Professionals 7-23-26.pdf). Full PDF lists SEPTAGE HAULER, SERVICE PROVIDER, and INSTALLER sections; this table includes only the 25 SEPTAGE HAULER rows. Spellings kept as printed including TRENTELS DESIGN & LANSCAPING, UNITED RENTALS ( NORTH AMERICIA), Attn: Melissa, Harrison Ohio, and West College Corner Indiana. EXNIL GREASE LLC and TRENTELS have no phone on the PDF. EXNIL hauler address prints CINCINNATI, OH with no ZIP. Rumpke phone kept as printed with X7015. Local license numbers (…SH / 50DSH) are as printed. The PDF Bond Company column is not ODH statewide bond verification (odh_bond marked unknown). A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with Butler County Health District and ODH before you hire.
